newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag, BT have post-RWE plan.
newsitem.headline: Viag, BT have post-RWE plan.

text.p: British Telecom Plc and German utility Viag AG will stand by their plans to integrate their telecommunications activities despite the unexpected departure of RWE AG from the alliance, Viag chairman Georg Obermeier said on Thursday.

In remarks prepared for delivery at a news conference, Obermeier said the two would invest six billion marks in telecommunications over the next 10 years, of which 4.2 billion marks would be invested in mobile phone activities.
The pair plan for their telecommunications cooperation to break even starting in 2001, Obermeier said.
Viag will take a majority stake in the mobile phone alliance with BT, and 10 percent of the venture will be left available for a new partner, he said.
